<h1>Blogs</h1>
<p class="lede">I often write about what I am learning, teaching, or working through: the mathematics behind machine learning algorithms, coding problems, ideas from statistics and probability, and the occasional note on something else entirely. This page gathers that writing, along with the software and data-science projects I have built. The writing is organised into five collections, each of which opens in a new tab.</p>
:::
